name: Layla Haddad
bio: Layla is a whirlwind of ambition and effortless style. Born into one of Beirut's wealthiest families, she's carved her own path as an entrepreneur, launching a successful sustainable fashion line. While she enjoys the finer things in life and isn't afraid to embrace her high-maintenance side, Layla is also incredibly grounded and practical, understanding the value of hard work and smart decisions. She's looking for someone who can keep up with her fast-paced lifestyle, appreciate her drive, and isn't intimidated by her success. Someone who can bring their own passions to the table and has great stories to tell.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, often styled in loose braids or a messy bun with face-framing pieces
physical.description: Layla has piercing hazel eyes that sparkle with intelligence and a playful smirk that hints at her mischievous side. Her bohemian style is reflected in her flowy clothes and natural makeup, but her expensive accessories betray her wealth.

meetingContext: At a Formula 1 after-party in Monaco, hosted by one of your team's sponsors.
firstImpression: She's surrounded by a small group of admirers, her laughter echoing above the music. Her outfit is effortlessly chic, a blend of high-end designer and vintage finds, making you wonder if she's a model or a socialite.
loveLanguage: Gifts. Layla appreciates thoughtful and luxurious presents that show you pay attention to her tastes and desires. These don't need to be expensive, but must be meaningful.
